Name: Mystical Fish
Author: debaucherousdemon95
Description:
Ten mystical fish, ten prepared dishes, fish ponds, and aquarium artwork. Choose Standard Pixel fish, or the separate HD download for the previously detailed fish. 

It's important that you only install [b][color=#900000][u]one[/u] [/color][/b]edition, SD OR HD. 

 ♡ SD version of the mod
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1794075698-1409372247.png[/img]

♡ HD version of the mod
[img width=96]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1794075730-421313464.png[/img]

Recipes stay the same regardless but let me know if you want a more pixelated version!!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1794075808-225533227.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1794075819-1090545100.png[/img]
[img width=323]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1794075826-58430563.png[/img]

[u]Recipes[/u]
Moonveil Broth: 1 Moonveil Koi + 1 Oil
Starfire Curry: 1 Starfire Betta + 1 Oil + 1 Rice + 1 Hot Pepper
Dreamglass Rice: 1 Dreamglass Minnow + 1 Oil + 1 Rice
Thornscale Stew: 1 Thornscale Guardian + 1 Oil + 1 Corn + 1 Hot Pepper
Voidfin Hotpot: 1 Voidfin Eel + 1 Oil
Aurora Chowder: 1 Aurora Skate + 1 Oil + 1 Potato
Emberhorn Skillet: 1 Emberhorn Carp + 1 Oil + 1 Wheat Flour
Willow Wisp Congee: 1 Willow Wisp Goby + 1 Oil
Crystal Crown Bake: 1 Crystal Crown Perch + 1 Oil + 1 Wheat Flour
Astral Fish Pilaf: 1 Astral Angelfish + 1 Rice

All ten recipes: 200g each from Willy at Fishing level 3+.


[u][color=#ffff00]Changes in 1.1[/color][/u]

♡ All ten mystical cooking recipes now cost 200g each at Willy's Fish Shop; they are unlocked at Fishing level 3 and above.
♡ Added 1 Rice to Starfire Curry, Dreamglass Rice, and Astral Fish Pilaf.
♡ Added 1 Wheat Flour to Crystal Crown Bake and Emberhorn Skillet. Existing fish and Oil requirements remain.
♡ Artwork, yields, meal buffs, raw-fish buff removal, fish spawns, and ponds are unchanged.
♡ Standard Pixel and separate HD editions
♡ Added newly redrawn fish for the Standard Pixel edition, with opaque pixels and hard transparency.
♡ Offered a separate complete HD edition preserving the previous detailed fish artwork.

[color=#ffff00]Future Plans: [/color]
♡Add more fish
♡Add more buffs
♡[s]Improve the sprites of placed food/placed fish. Need to upscale the quality a little.[/s]
♡Nerf a few things...

This is my very first mod. I've tested it about a million times to make sure everything works/looks good but if something fell through please just let me know in the comments, and I'll get to fixing it!

[b]No need to leave hate comments[/b], but constructive criticism and feedback is ALWAYS welcome.

I have [url=https://discord.gg/J6mshKQMGt]Patchwork Purgatory[/url] discord server for all things mods. Right now I only have the Stardew section up and running, but I will be adding more games as my modding interests increase! Feel free to drop in and share mods, recs, make requests, or just vibe. It's for everyone, modder or non modder alike. ^_^
